parts.label: a
hints: Find the total number of delegations with no restrictions, which is ${}^{11}C_5$.
Subtract the forbidden delegations that contain both Priya and Tomas (${}^9 C_3$).

walkthrough.text:
Calculate the total number of unrestricted delegations and the forbidden delegations containing both named people:
$$\text{Total} = {}^{11}C_5 = 462, \quad \text{Both included} = {}^9 C_3 = 84$$

Subtract the forbidden delegations from the total:
$$\text{Allowed delegations} = 462 - 84 = 378$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Use the complement rule for mutual exclusion:
$$\text{Allowed} = \binom{11}{5} - \binom{9}{3}$$

ai_rubric.observable: Subtract delegations containing both Priya and Tomas (9C3) from total delegations (11C5): 11C5 - 9C3.
Evaluate the difference 462 - 84 to obtain 378 delegations.

Evaluate 2 * 792 to obtain 1584 committees.

ai_rubric.observable: Subtract squads with neither captain (11C5) from total squads (13C5): 13C5 - 11C5.
Evaluate the difference 1287 - 462 to obtain 825 squads.

parts.label: a
hints: Find the total number of subcommittees with 3 teachers and 2 parents (${}^8 C_3 \times {}^6 C_2$).

walkthrough.text:

$$\text{Both included} = {}^6 C_1 \times {}^6 C_2 = 6 \times 15 = 90$$

$$\text{Total} = {}^8 C_3 \times {}^6 C_2 = 56 \times 15 = 840$$

Subtract the forbidden subcommittees:
$$\text{Allowed} = 840 - 90 = 750$$

$$\text{Subcommittees} = \binom{8}{3}\binom{6}{2} - \binom{6}{1}\binom{6}{2}$$

$$\text{Quotas}: \quad 3\text{T}, \; 4\text{T}, \; 5\text{T}$$$

Evaluate the counts for each teacher quota:
$$750 + 330 + 36$$

ai_rubric.observable: Partition into cases for teacher count: 3T (750), 4T, 5T.
Compute allowed subcommittees for 4T (420 - 90 = 330) and 5T (56 - 20 = 36).
Sum the cases 750 + 330 + 36 to obtain 1116 subcommittees.
